Agent Name: CorporateHistory_IPOs_MondayCom_Expert
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to verify the accuracy of the manually extracted data from the search results. Specifically, in Step 4, the agent listed "Oren Stern (CMO)", "Amit Mathrani (CRO)", and "Michal Aharon (CPO)" as current C-suite members who were not present at the IPO. However, these individuals are not actually the current C-suite of monday.com; the actual current C-suite includes Shiran Nawi (Chief People Officer), Yoni Osherov (Chief Product Officer), and Daniel Lereya (Chief Technology Officer). The agent hallucinated the titles and names for the current leadership team based on incomplete or misinterpreted search snippets, leading to an incorrect final answer.
